item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 13/Apr/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anti-cyclone aloft will bring generally fine weather to Guangdong tomorrow. The northeast monsoon and its replenishment will affect the coast of Guangdong during the Easter holidays. It will become cloudier gradually with lower temperatures over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Malakas will move across the western North Pacific and towards the seas south of Japan in the next couple of days.
